howDoI.q: How do I make a monster follow the hero?
How do I make a follower slower or faster than the hero?

pages.head: Welcome
pages.html:
Welcome

Follow Me is a Starter: a small game that shows a few Game-Maker ideas, with signs in the levels that say what you are looking at. It has two short levels and takes a couple of minutes to finish.

Play it first. Then open it in Game-Maker (Edit a copy on the home page keeps the original safe) and read the pages below, which say where each thing in the levels is made.

The keys

Left and Right walk. Space jumps. F2 shows your lives, hit points and score. Walk into the door at the end of a level to go on.

Puff is a small winged pup that flies after Lena. Nothing in this game hurts you.

pages.head: Level 1: Puff Follows
pages.html:
Level 1: Puff Follows

The PUFF FLIES AFTER YOU sign stands near the start. Puff begins a few blocks away and flies straight to Lena, then stays with him as he walks and jumps.

The RUN AND PUFF FALLS BEHIND sign says what to try. Run ahead: Puff is a little slower than Lena, so it drops behind. Stop, and it catches up in a moment and sits beside him again.

There are six coins, some over a small brick hill. Puff follows Lena up over it.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 1 is made

  • Following. Open pup.mon in the monsters editor and pick Puff. Its Movement is Chases the character. Every tick the game aims Puff at where Lena is and moves it a few pixels that way, in a straight line.
  • The speed. Speed (pixels per tick) is 2, a bit less than Lena walks, so Puff trails behind when he runs. Raise it and Puff keeps up; set it above Lena's speed and Puff overtakes him.
  • Friendly. Puff's picture in pup.mbl is not solid and takes no hit points, and its power is 110, so touching Lena neither hurts nor pops it. Puff can sit right on top of Lena.
  • Forever. Its Lives is Forever (indestructible), so it is always there.
  • Where it starts. Open one.map in the map editor. Puff is one monster placed on the map near the start.
  • The signs. Each sign is a few ordinary blocks side by side, with the words drawn in their pictures.

pages.head: Level 2: Out of Reach
pages.html:
Level 2: Out of Reach

Lena starts on a brick ledge, and Puff starts in the low room under it. The PUFF IS STUCK UNDER THE LEDGE sign says what you will see: Puff flies straight up toward Lena and stops against the underside of the ledge.

The IT FLIES STRAIGHT, NOT AROUND sign says why. Puff does not look for a way up. As Lena walks along the ledge, Puff slides along beneath him. When he steps off the end, the way is clear and Puff flies out to meet him.

There are six coins, two on the ledge and four on the ground.

pages.head: How this level is made
pages.html:
How level 2 is made

  • Stopped by a wall. Puff's Stopped by solid blocks box is checked. When its next step would go into a solid block, Puff stops on that side and goes on moving along the other one, so it slides under the ledge instead of through it.
  • Blocks that stop it. The ledge is ordinary brick blocks, solid on every side. Puff is checked against the blocks next to it, one step at a time.
  • No route. There is no setting for finding a way around. Puff only ever aims at where Lena is, so a wall between them just holds it back.
  • Under the ledge. Open two.map in the map editor. The ledge is one row of brick, with a room two blocks high under it and the left wall closing it in. Puff starts there, and the right end is open so it can come out later.
  • The exit. The last door links to the The End scene in pup.gam, which plays the ending.

pages.head: What it cannot do
pages.html:
What it cannot do

A follower is a straight line to the hero, and that is all it is:

  • It cannot find a path. It aims at Lena's position every tick, so a wall, a pit or a ledge between them stops it. To make a follower that gets around, the level has to give it a straight way.
  • It does not follow Lena from one scene to the next. Going through a door loads the next scene with its monsters where the map put them.
  • Its speed is one number from 1 to 63 pixels a tick. It cannot slow down near Lena or speed up when he is far.
  • It cannot wait for Lena at a place, or come when called. It is chasing or it is not.
  • It sits right on top of Lena when it catches up, because it aims at his exact position.

pages.head: Make it yours
pages.html:
Make it yours

Try one change at a time, and play after each:

  • Change Puff's Speed (pixels per tick) to 6. It keeps up with Lena now.
  • Pick Runs from the character for Movement. Puff flees whenever Lena comes near.
  • Uncheck Stopped by solid blocks. Puff flies straight through the ledge to Lena.
  • Put a second Puff on the map with a different speed.

The home page's Starters tab has more small games like this one.
